These are unverified mathematical proof drafts. Retain smooth integral projective X, an algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field k of arbitrary cardinality, and every actual big rational line bundle L. PSH(L) is the original cone of generically finite usc all-point decreasing limits of one actual FS net in rational bundles B_i whose numerical classes tend to c1(L). Actual section tensors and canonical metric scalars are retained. The sole equation grant is the exact supplied actual-AMPLE G0 body, preserved in evidence/supplied-14.txt, assignment LF2181–2581. Its actual ample/projective/geometrically-unibranch/algebraically-closed/trivial/characteristic-zero scope is retained. The supplied nef-and-big drafts are not equation premises.

Fresh primary evidence is Boucksom–Jonsson, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.07183v2, nine pages, arXiv 6 September 2023/manuscript 7 September 2023. Theorem A and Corollaries 2.1/2.2 give the genuine intrinsic reference V_L=P_L(0), generic value zero, genuine envelopes and compact normalized divisorial topology. Complete pertinent proof units are retained with observed renderer labels 0–257 and 324–405. These are envelope/reference premises, not equation grants; their resolution, multiplier-ideal and numerical-topology foundations remain explicitly declared background.

For a rational PL obstacle f, uniform multiplier-ideal generation gives actual FS functions g_m=f+phi_bm/m+f_A/m in L+A/m, with one fixed actual ample A and f_A shifted nonnegative. Subadditivity b_ml subset b_m^l gives phi_bml/(ml)<=phi_bm/m; also f_A/(ml)<=f_A/m. Thus divisibility indexes one decreasing original FS net. A shifted nonzero big section supplies a generically finite lower competitor, and the section criterion gives Q_L(f)<=g_m<=f+f_A/m. Its endpoint belongs to the literal cone directly. Complete Lemma 1.5 identifies Q_L=P_L off the augmented base locus; full-support divisorial valuations lie there. Common ample all-point order identifies the endpoint with P_L(f). For f=0 this constructs a defining net for V_L without the disputed abstract flattening lemma.

New general obstruction: PSH(L) intersect the published ambient signed space E-tilde-one is empty when L is nonnef. The scaling action t dot u(v)=t u(t^{-1}v) preserves FS class and multiplies its weights by t. It bijects zero-obstacle competitors, hence fixes V_L. Embed the cone in an actual ample Omega with Omega-L ample. If V_L had finite Omega energy, ample scaling gives E_Omega(V_L)=E_Omega(2 dot V_L)=2E_Omega(V_L), so its energy is zero. Since its supremum is zero, J=0; the granted ample I,J inequality and all-point separation force V_L=0. But a bounded genuine L-potential forces its defining FS stages to be generating, hence their bundles semiample and their numerical limit nef. This contradicts nonnefness. Thus V_L has infinite negative Omega energy. Every normalized u<=V_L also has infinite negative Omega energy by upward finite-energy closure. BJ Lemma 7.13 at the actual ample Omega identifies E-tilde-one intersect PSH(Omega) with E1(Omega), excluding every u, including max(u,V_L-k).

Fresh complete BJv4 scaling and membership proofs are at renderer labels 5202–5222, 5369–5402 and 5589–5637, https://arxiv.org/pdf/1801.08229v4, dated 24 March 2022. notes.detailedSummary: The algebraic Zariski decomposition L=P+N yields PSH(L)=log||s_N||+PSH(P), a unique actual residual and all-point order isomorphism. A uniform negative-matrix coefficient bound controls every effective numerical approximation. Actual sections factor in divisible powers. Compact approaching ample cones and an explicit single-net nef-intersection lemma establish residual membership without assuming that factored stages decrease. N is intrinsic, V_L=log||s_N|| and vol(L)=P². An entire intrinsic nef-and-big equation for arbitrary P is not adopted from the unreviewed drafts.
notes.text:
Retain the field, original cone and exactly scoped ample premises recorded in n1, now with dim X=2. Import the algebraic Zariski theorem with freshly checked complete pertinent proof: Thomas Bauer, https://arxiv.org/pdf/0712.1576v1, four pages, arXiv 10 December 2007/manuscript 7 November 2007, renderer labels 6–200. A section of a divisible big bundle supplies an effective rational divisor. Write L=P+N as actual bundles, N=sum a_j C_j effective, P nef, M=(C_i.C_j) negative definite and P.C_i=0. No analytic equation is imported.

M^{-1} is entrywise nonpositive. Indeed A=-M is positive definite with nonpositive off-diagonal entries. For y>=0 and x=A^{-1}y=x_+-x_- with disjoint nonnegative parts, x_-^T y=x_-^T A x_+-x_-^T A x_-<0 if x_- is nonzero, a contradiction. For any effective rational divisor F of numerical class B, write F=sum d_j C_j+R, with R containing no C_j. With e_i=(B-L).C_i, nonnegative intersections of distinct effective curves give M(d-a)=e-(R.C_i)_i<=e, hence d-a>=M^{-1}e. If eta>=max|e_i| and c_j=sum_i |(M^{-1})_ji|, every F contains N_eta=sum max(a_j-c_j eta,0)C_j. This is uniform across every section and degree, and N_eta tends to N. At B=L it gives H0(mL)=s_mN H0(mP) for divisible m. The containment and maximality of the nef subdivisor in both directions prove that N is intrinsic; numerically trivial twists remain in actual P.

The needed nef section-volume equality is reconstructed from Kodaira vanishing, the intersection Euler polynomial and an actual restriction sequence. Choose smooth ample B with B-K_X ample. Then h0(mP+B)=P^n m^n/n!+O(m^{n-1}); restriction to B has O(m^{n-1}) sections by injection into an ample twist. The restriction sequence sandwiches h0(mP), proving vol(P)=P^n and, by section factoring, vol(L)=P². Fresh Stacks 0BEL and 02KH proof bodies and Mathew’s Kodaira proofs are retained. Their classical recursive foundations are declared. Finite-presentation descent and faithfully flat field extension preserve arbitrary cardinality of k.

A genuine nef-intersection lemma proves PSH(P)=intersection over rational epsilon>0 of PSH(P+epsilon T), T actual ample. For the reverse inclusion choose continuous fixed-ample FS majorants and add positive shifts. Given two shifted majorants, smaller epsilon and shift permit a late new majorant below both: its directed open comparison sets cover compact X^an. These triples form one decreasing original FS net with class limit P. Normalized approaching cones are compact closed subsets of a common ample cone.

For any original u in PSH(L), factor every original FS stage by N_i<=N furnished by the uniform coefficient bound, N_i tending to N. Its residual v_i is actual FS in B_i-N_i and has generic value b_i=u_i(v0), decreasing to b. The residual stages need not decrease. Normalize them and use common ample compactness. Each divisorial limit coordinate is u(w)-log||s_N||(w)-b. Every approaching P+epsilon T cone contains a tail, so a cluster lies in their intersection and genuinely in PSH(P). Multiplying its defining net by s_N gives a decreasing original net agreeing with u on all divisorial coordinates, hence everywhere. Thus PSH(L)=log||s_N||+PSH(P), with unique residual, divisorial homeomorphism and reflected all-point order. The normalized nef maximum principle gives V_L=log||s_N||.

This proves the cone/reference/volume statements, not an arbitrary surface equation. The entire intrinsic nef-and-big operator and equation for every possible P still need independent reconstruction; the supplied drafts are not grants. Full own proofs are P16.5-argument.md Sections 3–4. Run python3 rerun.py; its finite matrix diagnostics certify only their declared finite arithmetic domain.

The intrinsic target condition is mass d^n and finite dual against all residual E1 tests; a proved polar barrier forces exceptional-fiber null mass. notes.text:
This is an unverified narrower theorem, independent of the unreviewed entire nef-and-big equation. Retain n1’s field and exact ample premises. Let n>=2, q:X=Bl_p(P^n)->Y=P^n, H=q*O(1), E exceptional, and actual L=dH+aE for every positive rational d,a. Put A=O_Y(d), P=q*A and sigma=a log||s_E||.

Every actual rational bundle on X is uniquely bH+cE: push a divisor to factorial projective space and subtract its pullback; only E remains. An exceptional line and a curve avoiding p prove independence. Hartogs in the local polynomial UFD gives H0(X,bH+cE)=s_E^c q*H0(Y,O(b)) for nonnegative integral b,c, and after clearing rational powers. Therefore h0(mL)=binomial(md+n,n), vol(L)=d^n=:V, while L is nonnef with exceptional-line degree -a. Its ordinary intersection is L^n=d^n+(-1)^(n-1)a^n. For 2H+E on the surface, volume is 4 and intersection 3.

For every original defining FS net its bundles are B_i=d_iH+a_iE, eventually positive, with coordinates tending to d,a. Factoring gives u_i=a_i log||s_E||+q*f_i, with f_i actual FS in O(d_i). Normalize by their generic values b_i decreasing to b. Residual stages need not decrease, but lie in a common compact actual ample cone. All base divisorial coordinates converge to u(w)-sigma(w)-b. A cluster lies in every closed approaching (d+epsilon)O(1) cone. Since it is nonpositive, multiplying it by d/(d+epsilon) gives genuine A-psh functions decreasing to the cluster; actual ample decreasing closure puts it in PSH(A). Pull back its fixed-bundle net and multiply by s_aE; common ample determination gives equality everywhere. Thus the entire genuine cone is sigma+q*PSH(Y,A), an order isomorphism and divisorial homeomorphism. V_L=sigma. R(u)=q*v is the unique genuine P-function extending u-V_L off E^an, defined at common poles by that proved extension rather than subtraction of infinities.

For bounded residuals, construct original metric products in P using the published signed pairing only after verifying actual ample E1 membership on X. On a common model the measure is sum_F b_F product_j(P_j+D_j)|_F delta_wF, with b_F=ord_F(t) and w_F=ord_F|k(X)/b_F. Projection of the full central cycle gives q_*M_P(q*v_1,...,q*v_n)=M_A,raw(v_1,...,v_n). Components mapping to smaller dimension have degree zero; all multiplicities remain. Verified bounded decreasing continuity extends the model identity. Off E, the actual bundle identity L=P+aE in the nonvanishing divisor frame identifies these products with local original L-metric products.

An actual ample polar barrier excludes p. Take h from hyperplanes through p, normalized A-psh with poles exactly p, and b=1-(1-h)^gamma for 0<gamma<1/(n+1). Convex increasing chord majorants with slopes between zero and one prove genuine membership. Bounded mixed integration by parts gives capacity{h<=-t}<=n/t. Floor locality, the positive expansion t^n MA(z_t/t)>=MA(z_t), and layer cake give -E_A,raw(z_s)/V<=1+integral_1^infinity t^n capacity{z<=-t}dt. The barrier’s deep sets have tail exponent n-1/gamma<-1, hence b is actual E1 and b(p)=-infinity. All ample finite-energy targets and top/mixed outputs integrate b, so give p zero mass.

A compact-Hausdorff lifting lemma preserves the original carrier. If q:C->D is a homeomorphism off closed F=q^{-1}Z, a finite Radon nu with nu(Z)=0 has exactly one Radon extension Lambda(nu) from that isomorphism locus, with F mass zero and pushforward nu. Compact approximation proves regularity. If nu_i converges weakly and stages and endpoint give Z zero mass, then Lambda(nu_i) converges against every original continuous f. Choose a continuous cutoff chi equal to one near Z with small endpoint integral; (1-chi) times f composed with the inverse extends continuously to D. Its integrals converge and the discarded error is bounded by ||f|| integral chi nu_i. The same applies to positive integrable weighted measures. This identifies limits of preconstructed metric products, not an operator defined by prescribed targets. Here Z={p} and F=E^an.

For u=sigma+q*v with bounded v, define raw relative energy by the actual original residual mixed pairing: (n+1)^-1 sum_{j=0}^n integral R(u) M_P(R(u) repeated j,0 repeated n-j). Projection gives E_rel(u)=E_A,raw(v). Define u_k=max(u,V_L-k)=sigma+q*max(v,-k), retaining the unique residual, and E_rel(u)=inf_k E_rel(u_k). The entire actual reference-floor finite-energy space is sigma+q*E1(Y,A). Constants shift raw energy by Vc. Define top and mixed unbounded operators as limits of these actual bounded original residual floor products. Base metric convergence, polar exclusion and the lifting lemma prove convergence on every original continuous test; only then identify the result with Lambda(M_A,raw(v)). The mass is vol(L)=d^n. Cofinal floor levels, bounded reference changes and auxiliary ample choices give the same operator.

Original decreasing nets reflect decreasing actual base functions. G0’s mixed and weighted theorem followed by the lifting lemma proves arbitrary-net limits on all C(X^an). Every residual finite-energy test is integrable. Actual original psh weights z_i decreasing to an integrable endpoint are also covered: q*log|I_p|=log||s_E|| gives z_i=q*(a log|I_p|+w_i), an actual ample (d+a)O(1)-psh weight. The actual ample integrable-weight theorem applies under its stated endpoint-integrability hypothesis, then the lifting lemma applies. Absolute integration of sigma is not silently added to the relative target condition.

Both outer derivatives include original directions that do not descend continuously at p. For f in C(X^an), let f-tilde be its value through the inverse off p. Continuous cutoff functions give continuous base minorants g-minus and majorants g-plus with integrals approaching the original integral. The genuine envelope q_t=P_L(u+tf) exists by n1 and has finite-energy residual v_t. Base concavity gives E_rel(q_t)-E_rel(u)<=integral(v_t-v)M_A(v)<=t integral f M_rel(u). For positive t use the feasible competitor sigma+q*P_A(v+t g-minus); for negative t use g-plus and reverse division. Squeezing proves both derivatives at zero equal integral f M_rel(u). Outer energy retains the singular reference through genuine competitors and their envelope; globally finite continuous majorants are not used to forget that type.

A positive original Radon mu is solved exactly when its mass is V and D_rel(mu)=sup_u(E_rel(u)-integral R(u)mu)<infinity over the actual relative E1 space. This equals D_A,raw(q_*mu), equivalently integration of every residual E1 test. The test q*b forces mu(E^an)=0 as a consequence, not an independent support restriction. The proved cone homeomorphism transfers compact energy sublevels, energy usc, target-integral continuity, coercivity and actual dual attainment from G0 at the actual ample A. The base solution gives an actual original function u=sigma+q*v; the constructed-product identity and unique exceptional-null extension give M_rel(u)=mu. Every output has finite dual by base concavity. Equal outputs imply equality modulo one constant everywhere by base uniqueness and cone injectivity. Comparison and domination transfer through reflected order and exceptional null mass.

This is the entire cone and exact target image for the explicitly stated family, without restrictions on potentials or targets to toric, skeletal, countable or finitely generated data. The family itself is narrower than all big rational bundles. Complete proofs are P16.5-argument.md Sections 5–9. notes.text:
Retain n1’s field, original cone and exact ample premises. If c1(L)=0, let b_i=u_i(v0) decrease to b for a defining numerical FS net. For every rational epsilon>0, epsilon T-B_i is ample on a tail. Thus epsilon^-1(u_i-b_i) embeds into the normalized actual ample T cone, whose divisorial bound gives -epsilon T_T(w)<=u_i(w)-b_i<=0. Pass the tail limit and then epsilon to zero. Every divisorial coordinate equals b, hence every original value equals b by common ample determination. Constants are genuine from zero-weight generating sections in classes epsilon T tending to zero.

Bounded nef top products are positive of raw mass zero and therefore vanish. Raw top energy is zero; the intrinsic floor space is the constants-only cone, and the sole positive mass-zero target is zero. The equation is attained uniquely modulo constants. No probability normalization occurs. Section volume is zero in positive dimension: a nonzero section of a cleared numerically trivial bundle has effective divisor with zero ample intersection, hence no divisor; it trivializes that power, which has at most one section.

For the separate nonbig example X=P1×P1, L=p1*O(1), the granted all-point fiber statement with actual ample base and pullback of the defining net along a base section prove PSH(L)=p1*PSH(P1,O(1)) for the entire original cone. Its volume is zero since h0(mL)=m+1. Every bounded top product and energy is zero, and all genuine floors give zero energy and operator on the entire cone. The pulled function max(log||z1||,-1) is bounded genuine and nonconstant. The zero target consequently has solutions differing by nonconstant functions. Top-degree uniqueness cannot be retained here. This is not a universal impossibility theorem for lower-degree theories with a genuinely retained additional datum; none is established generally in this work.
